summary: A fun list of famous hits mixed with toddler videos, but typing 'baby shark' costs a life because a second Baby Shark video at #22 takes the guess. Fix that and it is a good daily.
reasons: Bug: 'baby shark' matches #22 'Baby Shark' (the Cocomelon upload, 4.39B) instead of #1 Baby Shark Dance, so the most obvious answer costs a life. Both simulated players lost a life to it.

Good mix: Despacito, Gangnam Style, See You Again, Shape of You are gimmes; Wheels on the Bus, Johny Johny and Crazy Frog are the fun 'oh right, kids' moments; Bath Song and Phonics Song are fair stretches.
Near misses teach well (Uptown Funk #11, Counting Stars, Roar, Sorry). Not Blitz-ready.
fixes: Rename #22 'Baby Shark' (uploader Cocomelon - Nursery Rhymes, 4.39B) to something like 'Baby Shark (Cocomelon)' and keep plain 'Baby Shark' only as an alias of #1 Baby Shark Dance (or drop it from #22), so the guess 'baby shark' finds #1.
The universe categories (Viral videos, YouTube videos) add non-video titles as costly unranked answers, e.g. 'Ronaldinho', 'I/O Brush', 'Myspace – The Movie'. Filter non-video article titles.
